PBRExterior - exterior PBR materials for the night jewellery-store scene
Prepared October 14, 2026. Not yet imported or checked in Unity.

Everything in this folder is CC0 1.0 or project-owned. No attribution is required, but
the credits below are given as a courtesy. Commercial use, modification and
redistribution are allowed. Exact source paths, commits and SHA-256 hashes of every
source and shipped file are in sources.json.

CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication):
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Poly Haven textures (CC0 1.0)
   Publisher license: https://polyhaven.com/license (read from the site source,
   github.com/Poly-Haven/polyhaven.com @ b1a6aa13, public/locales/en/license.json):
   "Our assets are all licensed as CC0 ... You can use our assets for any purpose,
   including commercial work. You do not need to give credit ... You can
   redistribute them ... even in a product you sell."

   AsphaltDry_*, AsphaltWet_*  <- "Asphalt 02" by Rob Tuytel
        https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02             (3 x 3 m)
   BrickFacade_*               <- "Brick Wall 006" by Jan Burghardt
        https://polyhaven.com/a/brick_wall_006         (3 x 3 m)
   Render_*                    <- "Plastered Wall" by Amal Kumar
        https://polyhaven.com/a/plastered_wall         (2 x 2 m)

   Downloaded as the 2K JPG maps (diffuse, arm, nor_gl, displacement) from the
   GitHub mirror github.com/ConcordDev/concord-cognitive-engine
   @ a9e29c84d175189ca890f013ed47ed8887e78a7d,
   apps/concordia-living-world/unity-client/Assets/Concordia/PolyHaven/Textures/
   (Git LFS objects through media.githubusercontent.com). The mirror's own
   licence covers that project's code only; these files are unmodified Poly Haven
   CC0 originals. Byte-identical copies were found in independent repositories
   (asphalt_02 normal: hicancan/njupt-map; brick diffuse: Michael115/ggj2024;
   plaster diffuse: PIC123/EMC-Passthrough-Online-MRTK).

   Voluntary credit: "Textures by Rob Tuytel, Jan Burghardt and Amal Kumar, Poly Haven (CC0)."

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. ambientCG materials (CC0 1.0), created by Lennart Demes / ambientCG
   Publisher license: https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/ - all ambientCG assets
   are released under CC0 1.0 Universal; redistribution, modification and
   commercial use are permitted and attribution is not required (as already
   recorded for NightMaterials; the mercurypitch manifest below records the same
   terms, checked 2026-09-15).

   PavementSlab_*, PavementSlabWet_* <- PavingStones136  https://ambientcg.com/view?id=PavingStones136
   Concrete_*                        <- Concrete034      https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Concrete034
   Granite_*                         <- Granite002A      https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Granite002A
   LeakStain_ColorAlpha.png          <- Leaking006       https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Leaking006
        2K-JPG maps from the GitHub mirror github.com/achrefelouafi/ProceduralBuildingsThreeJS
        @ 6c19f1b1f14408353989ad26cda27f1e1ede5e91, blender/textures/<ID>/ (MIT-licensed
        code repository; the texture files are the unmodified ambientCG CC0 originals;
        the Concrete034 Color and NormalGL hashes match the copy in Terryoc2/Kinemind).
   FacadeStone_*                     <- Travertine001    https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Travertine001
        2K-JPG maps from github.com/mercurypitch/mercurypitch
        @ afdf5e3d84cdfe02458480505677724565b4c7b6,
        art/glass-adventure/v2/source-pbr/Travertine001/2K-JPG/ (the folder's
        manifest.json records the ambientCG download and the same SHA-256 values).
   RustyMetal_*                      <- Metal053C        https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Metal053C
        2K-JPG maps from github.com/KaanAres10/VR-Musicians
        @ fb97c8f628d7061b3ee18e0a1928348ca957028c, Assets/alley/rust-shading/.

   Voluntary credit: "Created using PavingStones136, Concrete034, Granite002A,
   Travertine001, Metal053C and Leaking006 from ambientCG.com, licensed under the
   Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal License."

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. Changes made (all by this project, October 14, 2026)
   - All maps resized with Lanczos to the sizes in README.md; normal maps
     renormalised and kept in the OpenGL (+Y) convention; roughness packed into
     <Name>_MetallicSmoothness.png as A = 1 - roughness, R = metallic, G = B = 0.
   - Poly Haven ARM maps split: R -> <Name>_AO.jpg, G -> roughness.
   - AsphaltWet and PavementSlabWet are derived wet versions (darker albedo, lower
     roughness, water in cracks and joints; AsphaltWet also has flatter normals in
     water). The PavementSlabWet joint mask was retuned on October 15, 2026.
   - PavementSlab: saturation halved and a slight cool tint (grey concrete slabs).
   - Concrete: albedo lowered by 20 % in linear space.
   - FacadeStone and Granite: the polished source finishes were re-authored
     (travertine roughness ~0.12, i.e. smoothness ~0.88; granite as a flamed kerb finish,
     roughness ~0.6, i.e. smoothness ~0.4, with sparse glints);
     faint relief derived from the albedo was added to their normals.
   - LeakStain: Color and Opacity merged into one RGBA PNG.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. Project-owned original work (no third-party content)
   MetalShutter_* (procedural galvanised roller shutter) and PuddleMask.png
   (procedural tileable puddle mask) were generated from scratch by
   Source~/build_pbr_exterior.py (numpy and Pillow, fixed seeds), written for this
   project with Claude on October 14, 2026. The project owns them and offers them
   under CC0 1.0 as well. No attribution is required.
